easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Yedora triggers, returning Bile Urchin from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Bile Urchin enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bile Urchin by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Bile Urchin face-up.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability from step 1.
Repeat.
